description: Trace a failing node up its dependency graph to find the underlying cause. Use this when something is breaking and you want to know which upstream component is the actual culprit.

errorId.description: Specific error event id from incident history; if set, the result is coloured with that error message

errorNode.description: Graph node id where the error surfaced, e.g. "database:payments-db"

project.description: Project name when the core hosts more than one (set NEAT_PROJECTS=...). Omit to use the default project.

name: get_root_cause
